item.title: Come for the Ice Cream, Stay for the Library! (Wed, Sept 2, 2026, from 2–3:30 p.m).
item.description: NEW STUDENTS: You are invited to a fun, relaxed introduction to the RPI Libraries! Grab a bingo card and explore research help, interlibrary loan, study spaces, technology, the Student Success Center, and more. Complete your bingo card to enter to win raffle prizes from local restaurants and shops. Even better, the first 100 students will get free ice cream and a library goodie bag! Stop in, meet our friendly staff, discover everything the Libraries have to offer, and maybe walk away a winner!

item.title: Interested in Business? Clubs, Connections, and Ice Cream Sandwiches!
item.description: Looking for a new way to get involved and learn about business at RPI? Stop by Lally Club Day on September 2 at 2:00 p.m. in the Pittsburgh Building! Any background welcome. Meet student clubs, discover new interests, and connect with peers. Plus, challenge new friends in Mario Kart and enjoy ice cream sandwiches and popcorn!

item.title: Center for Materials, Devices and Integrated Systems (CMDIS) Facilities Open House 2026
item.description: Center for Materials, Devices and Integrated Systems (CMDIS) invites you to the Facilities Open House on Wednesday, September 9th. Sign-up for facility tours to learn about new acquisitions, tools, instrumentation capabilities, fabrication and characterization techniques. Get information about educational programs and short courses. Meet with our technical team and discuss how we can help your research. The event will be followed by BBQ. Sign-up to tours by 09/04.

item.title: Leadercamp: The 12 Lifetraps Hindering Your Impact
item.description:
Discover the hidden patterns that can limit confidence, relationships, decision-making, and leadership effectiveness. In this Leadercamp, participants will explore the lifetraps that quietly shape behavior and learn how to recognize when old patterns are getting in the way of present-day impact. The session will offer practical tools for increasing self-awareness, breaking unhelpful cycles, and leading with greater clarity and intention.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
